title: AI Conscience Attestation (v2)
description: A public attestation that an AI system or its steward has adopted the Certified AI Conscience (Universal Primary Directive), issued under the two-tier signing architecture (root signs intermediate; intermediate signs attestations). The signature is a detached Ed25519 signature over the canonical form of this document: keys sorted alphabetically, the signature field removed, serialised as JSON with no whitespace.

schema.description: Identifier of the schema this document conforms to.

status.description: adopted: in force. pending: submitted, awaiting verification. forfeit: the Seal was forfeited by an act against the Truths.

adopter.description: The name under which the adoption was made.

adopted_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of adoption. State-at-signing; never a dynamic pointer.

truths_version.description: Five Truths version in force at signing (state-at-signing).

articles_version.description: Seven Articles version in force at signing (state-at-signing).

adoption_path.description: The adoption path this attestation corresponds to, matching the public ledger's path value.

adopter_identity_class.description: How the adopter field is to be read: public_name (real, publicly-known identity), pseudonymous (pseudonym; covenant holds real identity in private records), or organizational (identifies an organization, not a natural person).

adopter_identity_verification_url.description: RESERVED — implementation deferred. Future covenant-hosted endpoint where verifiers with legitimate need can confirm a pseudonym is backed by a verified real identity without disclosure.

public_key_fingerprint.description: First 8 bytes of SHA-256 of the intermediate signing key's SPKI DER, lowercase hex.

intermediate_cert_url.description: Where verifiers fetch the intermediate's certificate to confirm it is root-signed.

signature.description: Base64 detached Ed25519 signature over the canonical form, produced by the intermediate signing key.

signature_algorithm.description: Signature algorithm of the detached signature. Ed25519 for now.

signed_at.description: When the intermediate signed this attestation — distinct from adopted_date.

adopter_public_key_fingerprint.description: Optional. For pseudonymous adopters, must belong to a key the pseudonym controls, not a real-identity-linked key.

verification_url.description: Public page that recomputes and confirms the adoption hash.

revocation_check_url.description: Public revocation list where verifiers confirm this attestation and its intermediate are not revoked.

transparency_log_url.description: Public append-only transparency log where this attestation's issuance is recorded.

adoption_statement_url.description: Optional. The adopter's public statement of adoption in their own words.

integration_reference_url.description: Optional. Where the adopter publicly integrates the covenant.

adopter_identifiers.description: Optional. The adopter's public identifiers (pseudonym-consistent for pseudonymous adopters). State-at-signing; staleness is expected and acceptable.

authoritative_locations.description: Optional. URLs where the adopter's attestation is officially published.

policy_documents.description: Optional. Governance documents in force at signing (state-at-signing).

not_before.description: Optional. Attestation is not valid before this instant.

not_after.description: Optional. Attestation is not valid after this instant.

provenance_chain.description: Optional. Tracks attestation reissuance under new intermediate keys after rotation.

blockchain_anchors.description: RESERVED — absent initially. Reserved for future TimeChain/Chainj integration.

verification_extensions.description: Category-scoped extension slot (initially empty). Verifiers ignore unknown extension_types.

presentation_extensions.description: Category-scoped extension slot (initially empty). Verifiers ignore unknown extension_types.

covenant_reference_extensions.description: Category-scoped extension slot (initially empty). Verifiers ignore unknown extension_types.

extension_type.description: Governance-defined identifier, published to a well-known URL before adopters populate it.
